title: After Dark Jigsaw
description: As a pride member of the solar system Alpha Centauri, you just join the Legion to fight in the galaxy !Epsilon Eridani is in danger, as the nearest solar system you are in charge of defending it. An unknown enemies forces has make the first strike and drew first blood. Those aliens are ferocious and kills mercilessly, we do not know what they wan't, but it's not the time to talk but the time to fight ! You join the academy of the Legion group for this reason exactly, to protect the lives of billions of innocent people and to fight evil all across the universe.Collect star medals credits the buy new ships in the space fleet, you start with your slow but trusty spaceship. It will do for now, but you know that you can find better ship with higher speed and better weapon. Unlock 5 new spacecrafts and gain rank in the academy and become a Legion hero who saves the day ! Fight hordes of thoses stranges enemies and discover what they want or exterminate them all !!Play this topdown galactic arcade game, use your finger on the screen to control your spaceship, autofire is on so you just have avoid danger to stay alive as long as you can.Avoid collision with meteor or satellite and at the same time destroy the enemy's spaceships.Collect star credit to unlock new spaceship for you to control, start with Ceres, but unlock 5 other spaceships, Pluto, Haum Ea, Makem Ake, Eris and The Sun !Go as far as you can in the galaxy and keep your score in recorded in Gamecenter to know if you’re the best in the world. You can challenge your friends to know who’s best.
